description: Inspect the fixed public SC childcare search interface and its static script; the manual export contract remains unverified.
redirect_policy: Reject redirects; permit only fixed GETs of /provider-search/ and /js/providerSearch.js?v=2. Never execute search or all=1 routes.
retry: No automatic retry, browser fallback, or query-route fallback.
checkpoint: Complete sanitized interface receipt only; do not retain HTML, JavaScript, cookies, contacts or provider rows.
idempotency: Unique immutable assessment receipt per explicit invocation; no current pointer or release replacement.
cancellation: Abort pending transport and reads; remove only an owned unpublished temporary receipt.
retention_profile: Internal fixed URL, response hash/bytes and recognized interface markers only.
